head: codex/121-quorum-fence-restart-safe-epochs
title: [v0.92][WP-04.07] Support quorum fencing and restart-safe lease epochs
body:
Closes #121

## Summary
- makes activation-key possession operation-sensitive so a committed quorum can Fence or Revoke an unavailable holder
- commits Fence at exactly the next epoch and newer applied index while preserving the old signed portable recovery floor
- restores durable fenced state at the current committed membership index and removes the floor only after delayed valid activation
- keeps invalid epoch, holder, replay, capacity, and snapshot transitions atomic and fail closed
